name: menu_lookup
description: Look up menu items by partial name or category. Use this when the caller asks 'what do you have', 'do you serve X', or before suggesting a dish. Returns up to 6 matches with price, plus a speakable_summary string you can read directly to the caller. If `ambiguous` is true, do NOT pick one — ask the caller to clarify between the candidates in `matches`.

query.description: What the caller said the dish is, e.g. 'fish and chips', 'spag bol', 'something vegetarian'. Use the caller's words verbatim — fuzzy matching handles spelling and partial names.

category.description: Optional category hint when the caller browses a section, e.g. 'mains', 'drinks', 'kids'.

name: create_order
description: Place a food order for an EXISTING booking. Call this only AFTER create_booking has succeeded and the caller has confirmed every item, variant, and required choice (e.g. drink for fish & chips). Always pass `reservation_id` from the prior create_booking response. Pass the call_id from the Retell `call` object as `call_id` — the backend uses it as an idempotency key so a retry on the same call never creates a second order. Returns confirmation_message you can read back including the order number and total. Errors to handle by re-prompting the caller: AMBIGUOUS_ITEM (clarify size or item), MODIFIER_REQUIRED (ask for the missing group like Drink), MENU_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE (suggest an alternative).

call_id.description: The Retell call_id (use {{call_id}} dynamic variable). Used as idempotency key.

reservation_id.description: The booking_id returned by the most recent successful create_booking call on this conversation.

items.description: One entry per dish the caller ordered. Confirm each item, variant, and modifier choices BEFORE submitting.

name.description: Name of the dish as the caller said it, e.g. 'Fish & Chips'. Fuzzy matched server-side.

variant_name.description: Size variant when the menu item has one, e.g. 'Small', 'Medium', 'Large'. Omit if the caller didn't specify and the item has no required variant.

quantity.description: How many of this item, default 1.

modifier_choices.description: Map of group_name → choice. E.g. {"Drink": "Coke", "Extras": ["Extra Tartare", "Lemon Wedges"]}. Use a single string when the caller picked one, an array when they picked several.

special_requests.description: Free-text notes for this line item, e.g. 'extra crispy', 'no salt', 'allergic to gluten'.

special_instructions.description: Free-text instructions that apply to the whole order, e.g. 'kitchen please prep when guests arrive'.
